g.text: The two dictionary surfaces — same questions, different backing store
contains / frequency / rank are O(1) expected
(one HashMap probe). Ranking by frequency is free:
the rank, because entries are sorted.
Costs one String per word plus the index — roughly
feature. contains is O(k) in the word length (a trie
walk); frequency additionally encodes the word to a
varint unigram key and probes the n-gram store.
Always consistent with the model, and costs no extra
memory — but offers no rank, no log_prob, no top_n.
